# Nepal Fillings

> Nepal Fillings is a dashboard for sending email, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram and Facebook Messenger campaigns to customers in Nepal. Plans are priced in Nepali rupees by subscriber count and billed monthly or yearly, with a free plan for up to 500 subscribers.

Operated by Marketminds Investment Group Pvt Ltd, based in Kathmandu, Nepal.

## How each channel works

- Email campaigns, templates and automations
- SMS campaigns sent through the customer's own Aakash SMS account; SMS credits are bought from Aakash SMS
- WhatsApp campaigns sent from a WhatsApp number the customer links by QR code, through a WhatsApp Web client Nepal Fillings runs. This is not Meta's WhatsApp Business API.
- Telegram broadcasts to people who subscribe through the customer's own bot
- Facebook Messenger messages through the customer's Facebook Page
- REST API for SMS, WhatsApp, email and Messenger (not Telegram); live API sends use prepaid credits

## Plans

- Free: up to 500 subscribers and 12,000 emails a month; email and Telegram
- Growing Business: up to 50,000 subscribers; adds WhatsApp
- Advanced: up to 200,000 subscribers; all five channels
- Enterprise: more than 200,000 subscribers; pricing agreed with the team

Paid plans and API credits are set up by the Nepal Fillings team.
